color_tint.label: Tint with track color
color_tint.description: Recolor the visualizer toward the current track's dominant artwork color.

show_on_dashboards.label: Show on dashboards and cast displays
show_on_dashboards.description: Render the visualizer on the party screen and on dashboards cast to a TV or display. A cast display follows the visualizer settings of whoever cast it, live; only this switch (and a per-player choice) decides whether it shows at all. Note that TV and cast devices have far weaker graphics hardware than a computer, so the visualizer always renders at reduced quality there, adapting automatically to what the device can sustain.
